sections:
[CAN-1] Before the order ships (Cancellations policy; policy, current, effective 2026-05-01)
Any order can be cancelled free of charge until it is shipped, by the customer from My Orders in the app. The support assistant cannot cancel orders itself; it guides the customer to My Orders. The refund is initiated immediately.

[CAN-2] After the order ships (Cancellations policy; policy, current, effective 2026-05-01)
A shipped order cannot be cancelled. The customer can:
- refuse the parcel at the door. For cash-on-delivery orders nothing is charged. For prepaid orders the refund follows REF-1 once the parcel returns to the warehouse; or
- accept the delivery and return the item within its return window, if the category is returnable.

[CAN-4] Partial cancellation (Cancellations policy; policy, current, effective 2026-05-01)
Individual items in a multi-item order can be cancelled before they ship. Coupon rules in REF-4 apply.

[CAN-3] Grocery delivery slots (Cancellations policy; policy, current, effective 2026-05-01)
Grocery orders can be cancelled up to 2 hours before the start of the chosen delivery slot.
If the slot start time is not in the order record, ask the customer for the time shown in My Orders before confirming whether the cutoff has passed.

[REF-1] When a refund is initiated (Refunds policy; policy, current, effective 2026-06-15)
- **Cancelled before shipping:** immediately on cancellation.
- **Returned item:** after the item passes quality check, within 2 business days of pickup. ZentroMart Plus members: at pickup.
- **Prepaid order refused at the door or not delivered after 3 attempts:** once the parcel reaches the warehouse, usually 7 to 10 calendar days after the last delivery attempt.

[REF-4] Partial refunds and coupons (Refunds policy; policy, current, effective 2026-06-15)
If part of an order is returned, the refund is the price paid for that item after its share of any coupon discount. If the remaining order falls below the coupon's minimum order value, the coupon discount on the remaining items is deducted from the refund.

[DEL-2] Delivery fees (Delivery and shipping policy; policy, current, effective 2026-04-01)
Standard delivery is free on orders of ₹499 or more; below that a ₹40 fee applies. Express delivery costs ₹79 and is free for ZentroMart Plus members.

[DEL-1] Delivery times (Delivery and shipping policy; policy, current, effective 2026-04-01)

| Standard | 3 to 6 business days | 5 to 9 business days |
| Express (selected pincodes) | Next business day if ordered before 2 pm, otherwise the business day after | Not available |

Each order shows a promised delivery date at checkout. That date is the commitment.

[PAY-2] Cash on delivery (Payments and cash on delivery; policy, current, effective 2026-04-01)
COD is available on orders up to ₹10,000, only on pincodes where COD is enabled. A COD fee of ₹25 applies per order.

[DWM-4] Reported after 48 hours (Damaged, wrong or missing items policy; policy, current, effective 2026-05-01)
Reports after 48 hours are handled as a normal return if the item is still within its return window. Otherwise the customer can use the brand or ZentroMart Assured warranty, if any.
